scenes.headline: THE BLUFF
scenes.text: In nineteen thirty-six, Hitler sent troops into the Rhineland with orders to run if France fought back.

scenes.headline: THE BLUFF
scenes.text: France had the bigger army. It didn't move. So he did it again. And again.

scenes.headline: LAST CLAIM
scenes.text: Nineteen thirty-eight. He swears this slice of Czechoslovakia is his last territorial claim in Europe.

scenes.headline: PEACE?
scenes.text: Britain's prime minister flies home waving a paper. Peace for our time.

scenes.headline: PRAGUE
scenes.text: Less than six months later, his tanks roll into Prague.

scenes.headline: FAKE ATTACK
scenes.text: Nineteen thirty-nine. SS men dressed as Poles fake an attack on a German radio station.

scenes.headline: SELF-DEFENCE?
scenes.text: The next morning, Germany invades Poland and calls it self-defence.

scenes.headline: BUT WHY?
scenes.text: Okay, but why did anyone still believe him?

scenes.headline: NO MORE WAR
scenes.text: Because after World War One, Britain and France feared another war. And he used that.

scenes.headline: WRONG DOOR
scenes.text: Nineteen forty. The Allies rush into Belgium to stop him. But his tanks come through the Ardennes forest, behind them.

scenes.headline: THE HANDSHAKE
scenes.text: He even signed a deal with Stalin. Then, in nineteen forty-one, three million German soldiers invade.

scenes.headline: THE COST
scenes.text: Every lie bought him time. And millions paid for it.

scenes.headline: PAYBACK
scenes.text: But the master of lies got fooled back. By a dead man with fake letters. Follow for that one.
